svg.text: Messaging: Talk to Hermes from WhatsApp
Your agent doesn’t have to live in a terminal window — it can live in the chat app already on your phone.

g.text: A gateway that connects Hermes to a
chat platform, so you message the
agent like you’d message a friend.
scan the QR code on first run, then
flip Enabled. No API token needed.
phone numbers. Skip it and anyone who
messages the number gets your agent.
Home Assistant and more — same agent.
Same brain, same skills, new front door: ask Hermes a question from your phone and it answers with the full agent behind it.
